name: Media cube grid
doc: The picture as a field of cubes seen from a slowly swinging, orbiting camera (or a flyover, top-down, crane or spiral path): each cube is one cell of the image, its top that cell's colour and its height the cell's brightness; the bass raises the whole field, every beat a wave of cubes jumps out from the centre and the cube edges glow in the palette.

height.doc: height of a white cube, in cube widths

wave.doc: height of the wave that runs out from the centre each beat

gap.doc: space between cubes, share of a cell

swing.doc: how far the camera swings around (radians)

spin.doc: steady orbit, turns per minute x 10

edges.doc: palette glow on the cube edges (with the beat)

path.doc: camera path (orbit = the swinging orbit above)

kick.doc: kick level (bind an envelope): shoves the cubes up and dollies the camera in

punch.doc: how far a full kick shoves the cubes up, in cube widths

changelog.note: camera paths (flyover, top-down, crane, spiral; orbit stays the default) and a kick input that shoves the cubes up
